title: Phosphorus resource recovery based on a bio-electrodialysis system
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,908-919
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01165E, Paper
Pengchong Wen, Shengjie Dai, Zheng Ge
Integrated electric–microbial–chemical mechanism enables stable phosphorus recovery. Electric fields drive PO43− migration, microbes regulate electron flow, and FeCl3 induces Fe–P precipitation under optimal pH.
